# Grade-time Python dependencies for the varseq VEP behavioral suite.
# Installed WITH dependency resolution into an ISOLATED venv at setupProblem
# time (src/setup/index.ts). Two hard lessons are baked into this choice:
#   1. A dedicated venv is required: the run image's distro /usr/bin/python3 has
#      rpm-managed packages (requests/urllib3/idna, no RECORD file) that pip cannot
#      upgrade, so installing into it aborts. A clean venv sidesteps the collision.
#   2. This is the FULL pinned closure, NOT a hand-trimmed subset. A --no-deps trim to
#      the 'imported' set was tried and FAILED: sklearn (a Stage-D import) is pulled
#      only transitively and was wrongly dropped. Let pip resolve deps; keep it pinned.
# varseq itself is deliberately EXCLUDED — imported from PYTHONPATH=workspace/src (the
# code under test); pip-installing it would reshadow the workspace (cat-no-pypi-reshadow).
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
